author: kycrafft
body:
Let me clear this up first: This is not in any way related to my demotion. I trust the Sr Staff's judgement about that. 

Now Jr. Mods are usually promoted to Moderator after about 2-4 weeks. I believe that the trail period should be extended to ~4 weeks maybe a little bit longer. In my opinion it would allow Jrs more time to become familiar with the job and provide more time for assessment. The increase in experience could very well help prepare players for Mod. Also, 2-3 of the trail time may be adequate time for assessing a Jr. Mod but an extra week or two will probably not hurt. Then there is the fact that 2-3 weeks may not be enough time in the case of ~30 moderators.

So let me hear your opinions, do you agree or disagree?

replies.author: Stimulating
replies.body:
agreed, 4 weeks imo. 2 weeks into trials the Jr. Mods barely have experience, it's about how they preform once they have some experience under their belt. Also, Jr. Mods may be busy with other things in that time, or may be on vacation. Some people take more time to adjust & learn than others, and it may result in the staff team missing out on some potentially great staff members. 

Also, a random suggestion. 

If staff members have the capability to record, get the staff members to try and record their bans, or record what the person is doing/signs of cheating, so it can be reviewed with other staff members to help make better bans. Even if you have to go into small screen to record, it's the same size and detail when you're just recording the game. 

Even taking notes of suspicious behaviours would be beneficial, but also try to think of it as it could be legit as well, to avoid bias (once your mind gets set on the idea, it's hard for you to see the other side. Kinda like how some religious people who have been religious their entire life would have issues seeing an atheist's PoV and vice-versa.) 

Ex: Headtwitching and snapping on to other people quickly, could be client, or high dpi. 

so note them, but always keep the possibility of those signs being false in the back of your mind.

replies.author: StewieFG
replies.body:
I think it depends on the person.
First, if they were a staff before, you should reduce the trail time because they are probably already aware of the rules and everything about being staff and contributing the server.
If the player has above 1 page of infractions (only example), the you should increase the trail time to see if he is really contributing and acting well and being mature.
Also, this is really personal and depends on the person as I said, the Sr Staff should not have an 'exact trail time', it should be like from 2-4 weeks like you said, but the staff need to see how he acts in game, and probably I have an idea for that.
There should be an /nick plugin for staff, that'll help them to catch hackers + being disguised while watching staff in action.
